fields.label: Search by voice
fields.help: Hold the mic key and speak: Home Assistant's Assist turns the words into text for the search box. The microphone is open only while the key is held, and the words never run anything.

fields.label: Assist pipeline
fields.help: The id of the Assist pipeline whose speech-to-text is used. The default is the Local (Kokoro + Whisper) pipeline, so the words stay in the house. Empty uses Home Assistant's preferred pipeline, which is its cloud.
